text:
Brady Tkachuk spent eight seasons in Ottawa, five of them as captain, before the trade that sent him to Florida and onto his brother Matthew's team. Twenty-five games in, the fit looks right. He has 11 goals and 24 points, and 15 of those points have come on the power play, the clearest sign of how the Panthers are using him: in front of the net, at the center of everything with the extra man.

None of this is luck. His 10.79 expected goals (the quality of his chances) sit right next to his 11 goals, and his on-ice goals are almost exactly what the chances say. His 103 hits are still there too. The one soft spot is recent: eight points in his last ten games and a quiet return against the Senators on Nov. 25, 12 minutes and no shots. At even strength, Florida takes 58.9% of the shot attempts with him on the ice. Our numbers project 75 points and 34 goals, and on Wins Added he ranks 11th among 567 skaters.
headline: Brady Tkachuk, Panther, is a power-play machine
